name: Wriothesley
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on 4pc Disenchantment in Deep Shadow first for Stellar-Conduct teams, Marechaussee Hunter second (KQM's pick for every playstyle), Blizzard Strayer, Normal Attack > Skill > Burst, a CRIT Circlet and Cashflow Supervision first. Mains differ only by playstyle: ATK% Sands (EM for Reverse Melt) and an ATK% Goblet for Stellar-Conduct, a Cryo DMG Goblet otherwise; both Goblet stats are kept. KQM adds Gilded Dreams, Unfinished Reverie (Burnmelt) and Shimenawa's Reminiscence. His damage is Normal Attacks (1-hit 53.4% to 105.5%, ratio 1.976, physical curve), the Skill empowering them. Goals are Game8's: ATK 2,000-2,200 (upper), CR 50-60 with Marechaussee Hunter or 70-80 otherwise (80 used), CD 200 or above, ER 100-130 (KQM: 100-125 if he Bursts every other rotation; 220 or more if every rotation, which it does not recommend). Partners are inferred (Pyro for Melt, Anemo and Electro for Stellar-Conduct); the sources give no team list.
